en: n. a real or imagined line that marks the limits of an area, country or region; the limit of what is acceptable; the edge of something
ex: The river forms the boundary between the two countries.
這條河構成兩國之間的邊界。

en: n. a small class at a university in which a teacher and students discuss a subject; a meeting in which people share ideas and information about a subject; a lecture or conference on a special topic
ex: She attended a seminar on time management.
她參加了一場時間管理的研討會。

en: vt. to control or influence someone or something in a clever and unfair way; to move or handle something with skill; to change figures or facts in a dishonest way; to treat a part of the body with the hands in a medical treatment
ex: He manipulated the data to make the results look better.
他操縱資料，讓結果看起來更好。

en: vt. to make someone do something by using force or authority; to cause something to be necessary; to make someone feel that they must do something
ex: The heavy rain compelled us to cancel the trip.
大雨迫使我們取消旅行。

en: vi. to compete with someone for something; to argue or claim something strongly; to deal with something difficult; vt. to say that something is true
ex: Many teams are contending for the championship.
許多隊伍正在爭奪冠軍。

en: n. a very large house, usually belonging to a rich person; a large impressive building; (British) a block of apartments
ex: The millionaire lives in a huge mansion on a hill.
那位百萬富翁住在山上的豪宅。

en: vt. to tear something quickly and roughly; to pull something violently away from something; vi. to tear apart; to move very quickly; n. a long tear in cloth or paper; a strong current in the sea
ex: He ripped the letter into pieces and threw it away.
他把信撕成碎片丟掉。

en: a. relating to an area where people live; suitable for living in; relating to the place where someone lives; (of a school) where students live as well as study
ex: This is a quiet residential area with many trees.
這是一個多樹的安靜住宅區。

en: a. standing straight up; vertical and not bent; vt. to build something; to put something up in a standing position; vi. (of the body) to become stiff and upright
ex: The workers erected a statue in the main square.
工人在主廣場豎立了一座雕像。

en: n. a lack of agreement between facts, statements or ideas; a statement that is the opposite of another statement; the act of saying that something is not true; a situation in which two things cannot both be true
ex: There is a contradiction between what he said and what he did.
他說的話和他做的事自相矛盾。

en: n. a strong rough cloth used for making tents and sails; a piece of strong cloth on which an artist paints; a painting made on such a cloth; the cloth used to cover the floor of a boxing ring
ex: The artist stretched a blank canvas on the frame.
畫家把空白畫布繃在畫框上。

en: n. a spoken or written description of an event as it is happening; a set of comments or explanations about a book or event; a series of remarks on a subject; a description of a sports event on radio or television
ex: The sports commentator gave a live commentary of the match.
體育播報員對比賽做了現場實況播報。

en: vt. to hold someone tightly in your arms to show love or friendship; to accept something enthusiastically; to include something as part of something larger; vi. to hold each other in your arms; n. the act of holding someone close in your arms
ex: She embraced her mother at the airport.
她在機場擁抱了母親。

en: a. allowed by law; reasonable and acceptable; (of a child) born to married parents; vt. to make something legal or acceptable
ex: The company is a legitimate business with a proper license.
這間公司是持有正式執照的合法企業。

en: adv. as a result; for this reason; from this time or place; in the future
ex: The roads were closed; hence, the delivery was late.
道路封閉了，因此送貨延遲。

en: a. relating to the treatment of patients at a hospital or clinic; based on direct observation of patients; cold, detached and objective; plain and bare in appearance
ex: The drug is currently undergoing clinical trials.
這種藥目前正在進行臨床試驗。

en: a. so important or useful that you cannot manage without it; absolutely necessary; (of a rule) that you cannot avoid; n. a person or thing that is absolutely necessary
ex: A good map is indispensable for hiking in the mountains.
一張好地圖對山區健行不可或缺。

en: vt. to form an idea or plan in your mind; to think of something; to understand something; vi. to become pregnant; to have a baby growing inside your body
ex: I can't conceive how anyone could do such a thing.
我無法想像有人怎麼會做這種事。

en: n. a person who collects things as a hobby; a person whose job is to collect money, tickets or taxes; a person who gathers something; a device that collects something
ex: He is a coin collector with more than a thousand coins.
他是個收藏家，有一千多枚硬幣。

en: a. complete and total; very steep and almost vertical; (of cloth) thin enough to see through; vi. to change direction suddenly; vt. to make something change direction suddenly
ex: It was sheer luck that we found the keys.
能找到鑰匙純屬運氣。

en: a. relating to the president of a country; relating to the head of a country or organization; relating to a form of government in which the head of state is also the head of the government
ex: The presidential election is held every four years.
總統大選每四年舉行一次。

en: n. a room or space under the roof of a house; a space used for storing things; the top floor of a house; (old use) a small room under the roof
ex: We keep old boxes in the attic.
我們把舊箱子放在閣樓裡。

en: n. an extra amount of money paid to someone as a reward; an extra benefit; a payment made to a shareholder; something good that you did not expect
ex: The company gave all its employees a year-end bonus.
公司給所有員工發了年終獎金。

en: n. a quality or feature that is typical of someone or something; a characteristic; a thing that is a typical sign of something; vt. to say that something is the result of something else; to believe that someone is responsible for something
ex: Patience is an important attribute of a good teacher.
耐心是好老師的重要特質。

en: n. a game played on ice by two teams that use curved sticks to hit a small rubber disc called a puck; a game played on grass by two teams using curved sticks to hit a small ball
ex: He plays ice hockey every winter.
他每年冬天都打冰球。

en: n. a large thick piece of something; a large amount or part of something; a solid piece cut from something larger; (informal) a short, strong or stout person or thing
ex: He cut the cheese into big chunks.
他把起司切成大塊。

en: vi. to breathe in suddenly and loudly because you are surprised or shocked; to breathe with difficulty; vt. to say something with difficulty because you are out of breath; n. a sudden quick breath of surprise or shock
ex: She gasped in surprise when she saw the gift.
她看到禮物時驚訝得倒抽一口氣。

en: a. originally living or existing in a particular place; (of people) belonging to a place from the earliest times; naturally existing in a place; (of ideas or customs) natural to someone or somewhere
ex: The indigenous people of the island have lived there for centuries.
這座島的原住民已在那裡居住了好幾世紀。

en: n. the quality of being honest and having strong moral principles; the state of being whole and not broken; a feeling of being complete; wholeness
ex: He is respected for his honesty and integrity.
他因誠實正直而受人尊敬。

en: n. a room in a hotel, airport or theater where people can sit and relax; a comfortable room in a house for sitting; vi. to lie or sit in a relaxed and lazy way; to spend time doing nothing; vt. to spend time lazily
ex: We waited in the airport lounge for our flight.
我們在機場貴賓室等候班機。

en: n. the quality of being clear and easy to see or understand; the quality of being easy to see through; the ability to think or express yourself clearly; sharpness of an image or sound
ex: She spoke with great clarity and everyone understood her.
她說得非常清楚，每個人都聽懂了。

en: n. the way a person behaves; the way in which an activity is organized; vt. to organize and carry out an activity; to lead and direct an orchestra; to allow heat or electricity to pass through; vi. to direct a group of musicians
ex: The principal praised the students for their good conduct.
校長稱讚學生的良好品行。

en: a. very serious and worrying; (of a place) unpleasant and without anything to cheer you up; (of a person) looking very serious and unfriendly; cruel and without pity
ex: The doctor delivered the grim news to the family.
醫生把壞消息告訴了家屬。

en: n. the written text of a play, film or broadcast; the system of written letters used in a language; handwriting; the written text of an actor's lines; vt. to write the script for a film or play
ex: The actors received the script a week before filming.
演員在開拍前一週收到劇本。

en: n. a written request signed by many people asking someone in authority to do something; a formal request made to a court; a prayer; v. to make a formal request to someone in authority
ex: Residents signed a petition to stop the new road.
居民連署請願，阻止新道路興建。

en: n. a long low sound made when you are in pain or unhappy; a complaint; vi. to make a long low sound because of pain or sadness; to complain in an annoying way; vt. to say something in a low sad voice
ex: She let out a moan of pain as she lifted the box.
她抬起箱子時發出痛苦的呻吟。

en: n. a machine that produces electricity; a person or thing that produces something; a machine that makes gas or steam; a device that creates a signal
ex: The hospital has a backup generator in case of a power cut.
醫院有備用發電機以防停電。

en: a. happening or following one after the other regularly; every second one of a series; (British) another, different; v. to change from one thing to another and back again repeatedly; to do something in turn
ex: They alternate between working at home and in the office.
他們輪流在家和辦公室工作。

en: n. a small narrow river; a small stream of water; (American) a small river; (British) a small bay on the coast
ex: We crossed a small creek on the hiking trail.
我們在健行步道上越過一條小溪。

en: a. (informal) extremely foolish or unreasonable; (dated, offensive) mentally ill; extremely exciting; (of a plan) too silly to be taken seriously
ex: It would be insane to drive in this heavy snow.
在這麼大的雪中開車實在太瘋狂了。
